results.content:
Like a number of South Korean suppliers, Hanon Systems already supplies a Hyundai assembly plant in Montgomery, Alabama, and a Kia plant in West Point, Georgia. Based in Daejon, South Korea, Hanon Systems makes heating and air conditioning systems at a plant in Shorter, Alabama, that opened in 2003 and has expanded at least three times.

The company plans to begin production in May 2024 at a plant in a business park on the southern outskirts of Statesboro. [...] A majority of Hanon Systems is owned by a South Korean private equity firm, while the rest is publicly traded. The company has plants worldwide and was created by combining Halla Climate Control, and related businesses from Visteon Corp., Cooper Standard Automotive and Magna International. [...] STATESBORO, Ga. (AP) — A South Korean company will build a $40 million factory in coastal Georgia to make heating and cooling systems near a Hyundai Motor Group auto assembly plant.

Hanon Systems announced Tuesday that it would build the plant in Statesboro, with plans to hire at least 160 new employees.

results.title: Ship a Car to South Korea from the USA: 0% Duty on US-Built Cars
results.content:
Korea's 8% import duty on passenger vehicles was eliminated for US-manufactured cars under the KORUS free trade agreement. Origin follows the factory, not the badge: a Georgia-built Kia or an Alabama-built Mercedes qualifies, a US-titled car assembled in Mexico, Japan, or Europe does not. Korea then stacks three taxes on the CIF value (car + freight + insurance), each calculated on the running total. [...] PCS orders
 EPA Form 3520-1, box 7 exemption
 DOT Form HS-7, code C
 Military ID copy
 Korea-valid insurance quote for USFK registration

Our export team files the US paperwork; the origin proof is the piece that decides your Korean customs invoice.

## Wholesale vehicle shipping from the USA to South Korea [...] American-built vehicles clear Korean customs at 0% import duty under the KORUS free trade agreement. On a $30,000 car, that keeps roughly $2,800 in taxes and duty in your pocket versus a foreign-built vehicle.
